description.value: This Tim Hortons on 96A Street in Fort St. John is a full-service location with dine-in, takeout, and drive-through options, serving coffee, baked goods, breakfast wraps, soups, and snacks. It operates around the clock every day of the week, making it a reliable stop for cyclists at any hour. Fort St. John sits along the Alaska Highway corridor, so this location is well-positioned as a resupply point for long-distance tourers passing through northeastern BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the address (8804 96a St, Fort St John, BC V1J 6E2) and phone number ((250) 787-8467) matching OSM data exactly. The website explicitly lists 'Take Out' and 'Dine In' as features, corroborating OSM's takeaway=yes tag. No bike-specific amenities such as bike rack, Wi-Fi, water refill, or washrooms are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags, so all are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant confirmed active by OSM check_date 2026-03-05 and a live location page. Useful to touring cyclists as a 24/7 food and drink stop in Fort St. John.
